text: Day thirty. You're at your desk when your phone lights up. Unknown number. You don't pick up. It rings again. And again. In movies, this is where goons kick down your door. In real life, R B I has rules. That recovery agent can't call you before eight in the morning... or after seven at night. No threats. No shouting. No shaming you in front of your family or friends. {deadpan} So the next morning... the first call comes at eight oh one.
